description: Relative norm equations t t* = xi in Z[zeta_2d], d = 4, 8, with xi as coefficients over zeta^0..zeta^(d-1) and the number of solutions t up to roots of unity (0: none). Counts from PARI/GP idealfactor: the product of (e + 1) over the split pairs of prime ideals, 0 if a self-conjugate prime has odd exponent. Families: A random t, E products of small elements, B1/B2/Bsq times one or two inert K+ primes or one squared, C1/Csq times a rational inert-type prime or its square, D realistic xi = 2^K (2 - g)^r - u u* of z-rotation candidates at eps 1e-4..1e-8, P rational prime powers by class. log2 N_{K+/Q}(xi) in [20, 45].
